pui.translation: abbr. pupillary unrest index 瞳孔不静止指数

puing.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Pue
puing.translation: abbr. peptic ulcer 消化性溃疡；pickup

puisne.definition:
a. Later in age, time, etc.; subsequent.
a. Puny; petty; unskilled.
a. Younger or inferior in rank; junior; associate; as, a chief
   justice and three puisne justices of the Court of Common Pleas; the
   puisne barons of the Court of Exchequer.
n. One who is younger, or of inferior rank; a junior; esp., a
   judge of inferior rank.
puisne.translation:
a. 下级的, 其后的
n. 陪席推事

puissance.definition: n. power to influence or coerce
puissance.translation: n. 力, 势, 权力

puissant.translation: a. 强有力的, 强盛的, 有权力的

puissantly.definition:
adv. In a puissant manner; powerfully; with great
   strength.

puissantness.definition:
n. The state or quality of being puissant; puissance;
   power.
